12:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: College Football
The Panthers (5-2) visit the No. 1 Hurricanes (6-0) in an ACC matchup. The Hurricanes beat the Seminoles 43-35 in overtime behind three TDs from Darian Mensah. The Panthers fell to the Eagles 27-21 and rely on QB Mason Heintschel who has 14 TDs.
